description:
Records what actually happened for an estimate you made earlier, so the estimate can be compared with reality later (the calibration loop). Use this when the real-world outcome of a question you estimated is now known.

Returns estimate_id and the stored actual (value, unit, recorded_at, notes, source_inputs). Calling it again with the same values stores the same record.

Account only: you can record an actual only on an estimate made by your own account, and an anonymous call is refused with a sign-in requirement. To find an estimate_id, use list_my_estimates. When the user is not signed in, call the tool as normal. If the user's app supports sign-in, it will ask the user to sign in, and you can call the tool again after that. Do not send the user to their connector or app settings to sign in first. Only if the user's app cannot sign in (a REST caller, or an agent with no connector), create an account with POST https://fermi.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts (it returns an api_key once; a new account starts with 3 credits) and pass that key as the api_key argument.

Cost: free, but account only: recording never spends credits or a free estimate, and without an account the call is refused with a sign-in requirement.

actual_notes.description: Optional free-text notes about the actual outcome.
actual_notes.title: Actual Notes

actual_recorded_at.description: When the actual outcome occurred or was observed, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Defaults to now.
actual_recorded_at.title: Actual Recorded At

actual_unit.description: Unit of actual_value, if different from the estimate's own unit. Defaults to the estimate's unit.
actual_unit.title: Actual Unit

actual_value.description: The actual outcome, in the same unit as the estimate.
actual_value.title: Actual Value

api_key.description: Your Fermi API key. Required unless your connector is signed in. Get one with POST https://fermi.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts.
api_key.title: Api Key

estimate_id.description: The estimate_id returned by estimate_quantity_or_probability or listed by list_my_estimates.
estimate_id.title: Estimate Id

name: record_actual

billing.description: Who this call was billed to and what is left. Present on every Fermi result.

account_id.description: Account id; null without an account.

account_status.description: "created" if this call created the account, otherwise "matched"; null without an account.

anonymous_estimates_remaining_today.description: Free tier-1 estimates left today without an account; null for an account.

anonymous_quota_resets_at.description: When the free allowance resets (next 00:00 UTC, ISO 8601).

auth_source.description: How you were recognised: "bearer" (signed-in connector or token), "api_key" (the argument) or "anonymous".

charged_to.description: What this call drew on: the free daily allowance, account credits, or "none" (free calls).

credit_balance.description: Credits left on the account; null without an account.

is_unlimited.description: True for an internal account that is never charged.

title: Record the actual outcome (account only)
